statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
